comment: Tests that read files of, or build, other packages or the repository without importing them. kind read: a changed path that matches (prefix ending in /, exact file, or regular expression pattern) selects the dependents, whose own reverse dependencies follow; prose that a test reads is therefore not docs-only. kind build: the dependents compile those non-test .go files. scripts/test_ci_affected.py scans the tests and fails when a cross-package read, a build or a read of a prose file has no entry of the right kind.
